description: List sent/draft emails (email_drafts) for a lead (lead_id), a person (contact_id) or an organisation (account_id) — or with unassigned=true the SENT mails that belong to no record at all (e.g. sent with send_email before the contact existed); assign them with assign_email (draft_id = id). Each row carries assignment_state/assignment_candidates.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

unassigned.description: true = list sent mails that belong to no lead, contact or account

name: list_email_history
